title: Service OIDC identity fragment (supported)
description: Supported per-service identity contract for the catalog definition.oidc shape, the single identity source. Entry publication ready/published is active, retired starts explicit retirement (client disabled plus persistent tombstone; retired IDs never reused). No standalone services/<name>/identity.yaml exists or is consumed; compile refuses dual-editable identity keys. values.schema.json, _identity.tpl, and identity.yaml remain the normative enforcement. Realm fixed to applications; provisioning/issuance/rotation stay with the Keycloak owner (Code + PKCE S256, issuer https://<host>/realms/applications). Callbacks derive from approved exposures only; exposure fields stay with their owning contract. Confidential clients require secretReference in approval.secretReferences plus a scoped definition.secrets mount; the ExternalSecret reads vault item keycloak-client-secrets. Creates no clients, secrets, or routes.
